features.description: Background pump that fires recurring Timer/Cron start triggers, starting new workflow instances on a schedule through the stimulus router. Populates the recurring-schedule store at publish time. Compose alongside the Workflows Runtime Triggers feature and the Tasks feature.

options.description: Upper bound the sweep interval widens to under sustained failure.
options.name: MaxBackoffIntervalMinutes

options.description: Hard cap on due schedules claimed and fired per sweep.
options.name: MaxSchedulesPerTick

options.description: Baseline seconds between recurring-trigger sweeps while the host is healthy.
options.name: SweepIntervalSeconds

features.description: Background pump that fires durable timers, resuming suspended workflows (e.g. Delay) at their due time through the bookmark-resume dispatcher. Compose alongside a durable runtime persistence provider (e.g. Groundwork SQLite) and the Tasks feature to make timers restart-durable.

options.description: Visibility lease renewed while a claim-capable durable timer store dispatches one timer.
options.name: ClaimVisibilitySeconds

options.description: Upper bound the sweep interval and per-timer backoff widen to under sustained failure.
options.name: MaxBackoffIntervalMinutes

options.description: Hard cap on due timers loaded and fired per sweep, bounding both the store scan and dispatch bursts.
options.name: MaxTimersPerTick

options.description: Grace after a timer's due time before a no-matching-bookmark dispatch deletes the timer (covers a very short delay racing its own bookmark commit).
options.name: NotFoundGraceSeconds

options.description: Baseline seconds between timer sweeps while the host is healthy.
options.name: SweepIntervalSeconds
